name: Deals Leader
title: Leader, Corporate Deals Technology
description: Sees every deal, the portfolio and the money. Creates new engagements and watches risk; does not edit day-to-day work.

name: Engagement Partner
title: Onshore Engagement Partner
description: Owns the client relationship. Full control of own deals, approves stage gates and AI output for clients, closes projects.

name: Engagement Manager
title: Engagement Manager (AC)
description: Runs deals day to day: plans stages and activities, assigns people, keeps the tracker current, starts close-out.

name: Workstream Lead
title: Senior Associate, Workstream Lead
description: Leads a workstream (apps, network, Day-1, TSA). Edits activities and tasks in the stages they own.

name: Analyst
title: Associate / Analyst (AC)
description: Cleans inventories and updates the tasks assigned to them. Read-only elsewhere; contacts are masked.

name: Knowledge Manager
title: Knowledge Management Lead
description: Reviews close-out learnings, redactions and tags before they enter the AI knowledge hub.

name: Risk & Quality / DPO
title: Risk & Quality and Data Protection
description: Read-only on every deal. Sees the audit log and approves reuse consent at close-out.

name: Client SMO Viewer
title: Client Separation Management Office
description: Read-only view of their own deal. No fees, no internal emails, contacts masked.

name: Platform Admin
title: Deals Stack Platform Engineer
description: Runs the data layer: database driver, Google Sheet sync and Oracle export. No content edits.
